title: RESURRECTING ATLANTIS
lines: Resurrecting atlantis is an underwater data center.
It keeps 950 shots from 113 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 3 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Winged marble gates open”.
The tallest tower is RESEARCH PROJECT X-15 THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE X-15 (1962): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1903 or newer than 2018.
The sign most often read here is figure of enfeeblement.
